acceptance_criteria: cargo test -p stoa-imap passes; is_dev_mode() exists on imap AuthConfig; non-loopback dev-mode guard present in imap/main.rs; clippy clean
description:
## What
IMAP's local AuthConfig has no required field and no is_dev_mode() method. Add both, plus a non-loopback startup guard in imap/main.rs matching the pattern from the other daemons.

## Algorithm
1. Read crates/imap/src/config.rs fully — find the AuthConfig struct and Config struct.
2. Add to AuthConfig:
   pub required: bool,    #[serde(default)] → defaults to false (preserve backward compat)
   pub fn is_dev_mode(&self) -> bool {
       !self.required && self.users.is_empty() && self.credential_file.is_none()
   }
3. Read crates/imap/src/main.rs fully — find the startup sequence and where tracing is initialized.
4. After tracing init, add:
   let is_loopback = stoa_core::util::is_loopback_addr(&config.listen.addr);
   // or use a local helper if stoa_core dep not already present in imap
   if config.auth.is_dev_mode() && !is_loopback {
       eprintln!('error: stoa-imap is configured with no authentication (no users, no credential_file, required=false) but is listening on a non-loopback address ({addr}). Set auth.required=true and configure auth.users or auth.credential_file, or change listen.addr to 127.0.0.1.');
       process::exit(1);
   }
5. Check whether stoa-imap already depends on stoa-core in Cargo.toml. If yes, use stoa_core::util::is_loopback_addr. If no, add a local helper copy.
6. cargo fmt; cargo clippy clean; cargo test --workspace clean.

## Defensive programming rules
- required: bool must default to false via #[serde(default)] to avoid breaking existing configs.
- No unwrap().
- Error message must be actionable.

## Tests
Add to imap/src/config.rs tests:
- test_imap_dev_mode_no_users: required=false, users=[], credential_file=None → is_dev_mode()=true. Oracle: definition.
- test_imap_not_dev_mode_required_true: required=true → is_dev_mode()=false even with empty users. Oracle: definition.
- test_imap_not_dev_mode_has_users: required=false, users non-empty → is_dev_mode()=false. Oracle: definition.
- test_imap_guard_condition: dev_mode=true + non-loopback → condition true. dev_mode=true + loopback → false.
title: imap: add required field, is_dev_mode(), and startup guard
